label: Settings
settingsDescription: Configure your extension settings and preferences.
debugModeDescription: Enable debug mode to see detailed logs and troubleshoot issues.
themesDescription: Choose between light, dark, or system themes for the extension's appearance.
themeOptionDescription: Use this theme for better visibility in bright or dark environments.
resetDefaultsDescription: Reset all settings and configurations to their default values. This action cannot be undone.
dateTimeFormatDescription: Choose how dates and times are displayed across the extension.
